about:
Revere Plastics Systems operates a manufacturing facility in Ankeny, Iowa, as part of a company headquartered in Novi, Michigan. With over 50 years of experience in plastics manufacturing, the business has spent more than 25 years ranked among the top 100 injection molders in North America. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in public materials.

The Ankeny site provides value-added plastic injection molding, assembly, and testing services. Press capacity ranges from 25 to 3,300 tons, supporting projects from prototype through high-volume production. The company employs more than 1,200 people across its manufacturing, technical, and sales facilities, and offers design assistance, product development, material evaluation, and supply-chain management including third-party sourcing.

Revere serves global customers across a range of industries, though specific sectors are not listed. Its marketing emphasizes metal-to-plastic conversion, augmented engineering support, and the consolidation of multiple suppliers into a single logistics partner.

The company was founded to improve the global competitive position of its customers. Its stated differentiator is a “Flexible Thinking, Flexible Design, Flexible Delivery” framework, backed by multiple locations and redundant press space to prevent supply interruptions.
